question_text: A provided helper choose_order(order) rejects the first two ratings, then selects the first later rating exceeding both; if none exists, it returns the last rating. orders is a nonempty list of all permutations of ratings 1..5. Construct success_fraction(orders) in Python to return the fraction for which the helper chooses 5. You may call choose_order without implementing it.
adaptation_rationale: Retains exhaustive algorithmic counting/helper composition while using supplied permutations; no unsupplied permutation algorithm required.

marking_points.criterion: Returns count divided by number of orders using true division.

acceptable_alternatives: Equivalent technically correct wording or valid implementation earning the specified independent points.
partial_credit_notes: Award each stated point independently up to the total; do not double-credit the same idea.

verification.technical: Concrete marking points independently reasoned from the defined context and exact 2027 scope.
